changeSet.sql: UPDATE agent_run SET execution_owner = gen_random_uuid(), lease_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at IS NULL

ALTER TABLE agent_run ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_execution_lease CHECK ((status = 'RUNNING' AND execution_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND heartbeat_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'RUNNING' AND execution_owner IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND heartbeat_at IS NULL))
